sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 60 for 100 seconds.
Status ailment resistance value reduction effect boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Healing Ability Power 20. Heals HP. [Demerit]
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Ineptitude (decreases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Guilty Eclipse (nullifies newly applied buff effects, blocks max HP increase effects, reduces action speed by 30, and reduces HP recovery effects by 100% (Heal Resistance)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases maximum Cost by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
